notes: 2018_01 is the handbook and 2018_06 the agreement; 2018_02 is the same agreement as 2018_06.

Governing documents: the State/UUP Agreement 2011-2016 (2018_06), which covers academic employees (faculty), and the 2017-18 Faculty-Staff Handbook (2018_01). The agreement's appendices are 'explanatory statements of mutual intent', not part of the collective agreement; Appendix A-42 (Family Leave) states the seven-month child care leave under the Domestic Relations Law and the pregnancy disability rules, whose sources (Domestic Relations Law art. 7; the Civil Service Attendance and Leave Manual) are cited but not saved (governing document cited but not saved: coded as stated, flagged cross_reference_not_saved).

No employer-paid parental or maternity leave: HR pages state the University does not provide paid maternity leave; pay during leave comes only from own sick leave (disability period) and, for calendar/college-year staff, vacation. Academic-year employees (faculty) accrue no vacation (Art. 23.3), so vacation use is not coded for faculty.

Campus 'Parent Leave General Guidelines (Faculty)' on the HR page 2018_05 (capture 2016-04-19) are coded as the campus policy for modified duties (c14) and tenure-clock stop (c15); both discretionary. The Board of Trustees clock-stop policy (c16) is known only from a 2020 form (version_uncertain).
Appendix A-42's encouragement of 'flexible work schedules, modified duties, alternative work assignments, and temporary reduction from full-time to part-time work' grants nothing and is not coded.

Chain, birth parent: (pregnancy LWOP c11, discretionary) -> own sick leave for disability c2 (about 4 weeks before to 6-8 after delivery) within the 7-month child care leave c1, with FMLA c7 concurrent_with c1; after c1, discretionary extension c12. Medical chain for continuing disability: c2 -> discretionary paid additional sick leave c3 -> discretionary unpaid additional sick leave c4; disability leave c5 and LTD c6 unlinked. Modified duties c14 (discretionary, one semester) unlinked.

Chain, non-birth parent: 7-month child care leave c1 with FMLA c7 concurrent; own family sick leave c9 (30 days) or the HR page's 5 days c10 (summary_only) for spouse care; discretionary extension c12 after c1; modified duties c14 unlinked.

XIII Title F; Art. XV; 'Appendix A-46 of the Policies ... Article II(k) and (p)'); State University Group Disability Insurance Program; Faculty Bylaws; Management Procedures; FMLA request form.
